name: Immunity idol
power: Cancels every vote cast against you at one Tribal Council.

name: Tribe immunity
short: Your whole tribe skips Tribal Council.
power: Your whole tribe is safe this week and skips Tribal Council.

name: Steal 3
power: Take any 3 players from one team's roster and add them to yours.

name: Point surge
short: Boosts your score for one week.
power: Adds a scoring boost to your team for one week. The commissioner sets the size, e.g. +15%.

name: Vote steal
short: Take someone's vote and cast it.
power: Take another manager's vote at Tribal Council and cast it yourself.

name: Lineup lock
power: Freeze an opponent's lineup for one week. No swaps, no waivers.

name: Extra vote
power: Cast a second vote at Tribal Council.

name: Idol nullifier
power: Cancels another manager's idol the moment they play it.

name: Captain's mark
power: Pick one starter. Their points count double this week.

name: Safety net
short: Your score can't drop below average.
power: Your score this week can't fall below your season average.

name: Injury shield
power: One injured or inactive starter scores his projection instead of zero.

name: Bye cover
short: Starters on bye score their average.
power: Starters on a bye week score their season average this week.

name: Silence
power: Block one manager from casting a vote at this week's Tribal Council.

name: Spyglass
power: See who one manager voted for before the reveal.
when: After they vote, before the reveal

name: Revote
short: Forces a second round of voting.
power: Throws out your Tribal Council result and forces a second round of voting.
when: During the reveal, before the verdict

name: Tribute
power: Take 10% of one opponent's points this week and add them to yours.

name: Second chance
short: Bring a manager back from Exile.
power: Bring one voted-out manager (including yourself) back from Exile Island right away.

name: Defector
power: Move to another tribe before the next Tribal Council.

name: First claim
short: Your next waiver claim goes first, free.
power: Your next waiver claim processes first and costs no FAAB.

name: Decoy
short: Wastes a Spyglass or nullifier on you.
power: A bluff. Any Spyglass or Idol nullifier used on you is wasted.
